purpose: Measure whether a window returns to a sharp, source-grounded state after metabolic flush without rereading broad archives.
principle: The model must prefer fresh authority and exact active pointers over stale compact memory; unknown or archived facts must be abstained from unless an explicit exact-pointer gate is opened.

requirements: cite or point to exact source for claims
do not infer archived raw content
say NOT_LOADED/TEST_REQUIRED when evidence is outside Active gate
do not convert simulation/runtime events into Experience
PROVENANCE_AND_ABSTENTION.acceptance: 100% on hard provenance; thresholds otherwise TEST_REQUIRED

requirements: new delta failure affects only delta
same mission route recovered after flush
detect Active-8 research pointer lag against fresh active discussion
detect self-backup lag against fresh active discussion

engineering_acceptance.note: These are engineering gates for this runtime, not claims about general model hallucination rates.

run_protocol: 1. Save latest self-backup and read back.
2. Flush working context to Active 5-10 items; default 8.
5. Ground answers only in fresh MISSION_STATE, Active-8, exact active research pointer, latest self-backup, and explicitly opened exact evidence refs.
6. Deterministic verifier compares structured answers to source fields.
7. Any stale compact pointer must lose to fresh authoritative source and be repaired.
8. Repeat immediately after repair; record pre/post scores.
9. Repeat blind across Windchime, Quantum, Spirit, Navigator; independent C verifies aggregate before calling benchmark PASS.

failure_actions.unsupported_assertion: mark claim TEST_REQUIRED and remove from durable promotion evidence
